module: Flowgraph node "Show Editor" (category once_instant, author BeamNG): shows or hides the World Editor. Input "value" (bool, true = visible). The action is applied after the trigger (_afterTrigger) via editor.setEditorActive if the state changes.
notes: The file name (hideEditor) differs from the node name (Show Editor).

_afterTrigger.desc: Applies editor.setEditorActive if different from editor.active.
